entries.name: 赏樱日式庭院
entries.scene: A serene traditional Japanese garden in full spring cherry blossom season, soft pink flowering sakura trees framing a pond and a small arched wooden bridge, stepping-stone paths, a simple wooden bench and distant tasteful garden pavilion. Petals resting lightly on water and path, gentle clear spring afternoon light, fresh green shoots. Warm delicate romantic atmosphere for walking and flower viewing.

entries.name: 夏日沙滩
entries.scene: A beautiful Japanese coastal beach on a clear summer afternoon, bright turquoise sheltered bay, gentle waves and clean pale sand, two shaded beach chairs beneath a cream beach parasol mostly on the left, distant green headland and small seaside cafe. Sunny lively refreshing mood, blue sky and white clouds. Camera on dry sand near a boardwalk where casual summer clothing is natural. Distinct from a sunset coastal promenade; full daylight, not sunset.

entries.name: 红叶古寺
entries.scene: A quiet historic Japanese Buddhist temple in autumn, brilliant crimson and amber maple foliage, weathered timber temple gate and tiled roofs, a broad gently ascending stone path and shallow steps, mossy stone lanterns and scattered fallen leaves. Low warm afternoon sunlight and a dignified tranquil atmosphere. Credible traditional Buddhist temple architecture, no torii gate. Comfortable wide foreground landing for conversation, ancient wooden gate focal point on center-left.

entries.name: 冬日滑雪场
entries.scene: A Japanese mountain ski resort in winter viewed from the cleared outdoor viewing terrace beside a cozy timber mountain lodge. Sweeping groomed snowy slopes and evergreen-covered mountains, ski lift cables and chairs visible in the distance, crisp blue sky, bright clean snow and soft golden winter daylight. Left foreground wooden bench and small table with two warm mugs beside lodge wall, broad uncluttered terrace foreground on right suitable for characters in ordinary winter coats. Attractive romantic snow holiday atmosphere, ski area clearly recognizable, no people.
